vision_question: By when will compute in orbit be commercially viable?

feasibility.rationale: Launch + downlink + spectrum + power capabilities are commercially advancing; rad-hard compute is the binding constraint pending AMD MI300 rad-test.

capabilities.name: Radiation-hard compute
capabilities.description: GPUs/accelerators that survive LEO TID + SEU flux at sustained performance.
capabilities.rationale: Without radiation tolerance, orbital DCs face unacceptable error rates and lifetime. Currently the binding constraint on the vision — TRL 6 demonstration pending.

score.rationale: AMD MI300 rad-test campaign postponed to Q4 — slips both technical and supply scores.

capabilities.name: In-orbit DC assembly
capabilities.description: Robotic / human assembly of modular DC racks in orbit beyond single-launch envelope.
capabilities.rationale: Single launches cap DC scale at ~5 MW. Beyond that, in-orbit assembly is required.

score.rationale: TRL 4. NASA OSAM-1 mission delays; commercial alternatives early-stage.

capabilities.name: Insurance availability
capabilities.description: Commercial space insurance underwriters willing to write > $2B/yr per orbital asset.
capabilities.rationale: Capital deployment at orbital-DC scale (>$5B/asset) requires insurance market depth that doesn't yet exist.

score.rationale: Lloyd's reports cap at $2B/yr per orbital line; 2 carriers active.

capabilities.name: Tier-3 reliability uptime
capabilities.description: 99.982% uptime equivalent on orbital hardware — redundancy + sparing strategy.
capabilities.rationale: Enterprise customers require ground-equivalent SLAs. Orbital constraints (limited spares, repair latency) make this nontrivial.

score.rationale: Architectural studies converging on N+2 + cold-spare orbit strategy.

capabilities.name: In-orbit thermal rejection
capabilities.description: Heat rejection in vacuum — radiator panels, working-fluid loops at MW scale.
capabilities.rationale: All electrical input becomes heat; without effective radiative rejection the DC overheats within minutes.

score.rationale: Starcloud 1kW demo on track; scale-up to 100kW being studied.

capabilities.name: In-orbit power generation
capabilities.description: Solar arrays + battery packs sized for MW continuous DC operation through eclipse seasons.
capabilities.rationale: Mature technology; scale to MW class is engineering, not invention.

score.rationale: Solar perovskite W/kg gains shipping in 2026 production runs.

capabilities.name: Downlink bandwidth
capabilities.description: Optical comms uplink/downlink at Tbps scale + ground station network.
capabilities.rationale: Determines viable workloads: training is bandwidth-bound; inference can tolerate higher latency.

score.rationale: Mynaric optical terminals shipping; ESA optical comms milestone.

capabilities.name: Spectrum allocation
capabilities.description: ITU coordination + national allocation for Ka/Q-band orbital DC links.
capabilities.rationale: Ka/Q-band cleared 2024; minor coordination remaining for some constellations.

score.rationale: ITU process largely resolved; remaining is per-orbit coordination.

capabilities.name: Launch economics
capabilities.description: $/kg to LEO trending down via Starship class reusables; sets the floor for orbital DC capex.
capabilities.rationale: Single largest cost lever. Each 50% drop in $/kg roughly doubles addressable workload.

score.rationale: Starship V3 first burn validates -22%/y trend; Falcon 9 backlog clearing.

dependencies.rationale: Reliability assumes rad-hard chips meet SEU rates.
Thermal margin is a precondition for sustained uptime.
Power continuity through eclipse seasons gates uptime.
Spare-stocking + repair latency depend on assembly tooling.
Customer SLA on workload throughput depends on downlink reliability.
Cheaper launch lets you fly larger / more solar panels.
Spectrum rights gate the bandwidth deployment.
Insurance terms shape feasible redundancy budgets.

risks.name: ITAR / EAR export control
risks.description: US export controls block optics + rad-hard chips to KR/CN suppliers; risk to supply chain depth.
risks.mitigations: Dual-source non-US optics; license-exempt chip variants; political engagement.

risks.name: Orbital debris (Kessler)
risks.description: Cascade collisions in target orbit could render shells uninsurable / unusable.
risks.mitigations: Active debris monitoring + deorbit reserves required by insurers.

risks.name: Insurance market thinness
risks.description: No commercial carrier writing > $2B/y per orbital asset — caps project size.
risks.mitigations: Sovereign backstop programs; coinsurance pools across primes.

risks.name: Spectrum / ITU coordination
risks.description: Ka/Q-band cleared 2024; tail coordination items remain per constellation.

risks.name: CHIPS Act amendment in flux
risks.description: Proposed orbital-DC tax credit could shift capex economics ±30%; outcome uncertain.
risks.mitigations: Diversify across jurisdictions; lobby for technology-neutral language.
